{{Quote|It might be a long and dangerous chase, but in the end we will triumph.|translated=1|Chief Chirpa|<ref name="TMTS">''[[The Movie Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
'''Chirpa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] who served as the [[Chief/Legends|head]] of his [[Bright Tree Village tribe|tribe's]] [[Council of Elders (Ewok)/Legends|Council of Elders]] in the [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]]. The gray-furred Chirpa carried a reptilian staff denoting his rank which carried the teeth and horns of animals he had hunted. He and his wife [[Ra-Lee/Legends|Ra-Lee]] had two daughters: [[Asha/Legends|Asha]] and [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]]. Chirpa was also the brother of [[Bozzie]] and the uncle of [[Paploo/Legends|Paploo]].

==Biography==
[[File:Chief_Chirpa.jpg|thumb|left|Chirpa, Chief of the [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]].]]
As a young warrior, Chirpa earned the trust of his fellow villagers during the [[Ewok–Dulok wars/Legends|Ewok–Dulok wars]], and he later ascended to the position of Chief.<ref name="profiles">{{WebCite|url=http://www.cbr.com/exclusive-giallongo-introduces-the-ewoks-of-shadows-of-endor|text=EXCLUSIVE: Giallongo Introduces the Ewoks of "Shadows of Endor"|work=[http://www.cbr.com Comic Book Resources]|archivedate=20170922000536}}</ref> During his management, Chief Chirpa was known by his sapience and severity.<ref name="TV">[[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']]</ref><ref name="Marvel">[[Star Wars: Ewoks (1985)|''Star Wars: Ewoks'' (1985)]]</ref> Beyond this, he was one of the strongest Ewok warriors, and he knew at least one magic device: Chirpa used prism pebbles to tell legends and stories for the young Ewoks.<ref name="1-09">{{Ewoks|Sunstar vs. Shadowstone}}</ref>

His chores included the training of his younger daughter, apprentice, and heiress [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]], who was appointed as the Heir [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] against the initial opposition of the most of the [[Council of Elders (Ewok)/Legends|Council of Elders]]. For some time the Elders did not consent to have a female leader, but after Kneesaa led the Ewoks to victory against the [[Zorbian space pirates]], and after other tests, Chirpa agreed to continue Kneesaa's training and saw her becoming an honorary member of the Council.<ref name="rites" />

When his daughter Kneesaa was still very young, Ra-Lee was killed by a [[hanadak]] in the forest. It was believed that Asha was killed as well until they discovered several years later that she had been raised in the woods by a family of [[Korrina/Legends|korrinas]]. Chirpa was later tearfully reunited with his lost daughter.<ref name="1-13" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] during the [[Festival of Love]], he traveled to [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] on the invitation of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Kylantha]]. As he had no knowledge of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he was welcoming to both [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] alike.<ref name="Galaxies">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>

A few years later, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] started arriving on Endor's moon. Chirpa led a group of warriors to investigate the "strange creatures" (Imperial [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]]) which Chirpa said "smelled like fire, only worse." The Elders debated over what to do about the invaders. Chirpa reminded them about the invaders' power and decided that the Ewoks would not fight them. But when [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] saw an [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] stumble on some rocks and crash in the woods, he told Chirpa and convinced him that the Imperials could be defeated if the Ewoks built traps for them.<ref name="GalaxyGuide5">''[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref>

[[File:Logray_Chirpa.png|left|thumb|[[Logray/Legends|Logray]] and Chief Chirpa declare the [[Endor strike team/Legends|Endor strike team]] part of the tribe.]]
By that time, Chirpa had been chief of the village for forty-two seasons.<ref name="Databank" /> He also kept an [[Iguana/Legends|iguana]] as a [[Chirpa's iguana/Legends|pet]] and advisor.<ref>{{SW|url=news/meet-the-ewoks-from-endor|text=Yub Yub: Meet the Ewoks from Endor|int=Yub Yub: Meet the Ewoks from Endor|nolive=1}}</ref> When the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] arrived on Endor, he went along with [[Logray/Legends|Logray's]] idea to offer the newcomers as a sacrifice to the "[[C-3PO/Legends|golden god]]." But when he saw the powerful magic they were capable of, he realized that he had erred.<ref name="ROTJ" /> He decided that the Ewoks should listen to the newcomers' story. After hearing C-3PO tell their tale, Chirpa convinced the village elders to make them honorary members of the [[Bright Tree Village tribe|tribe]]. Because the Empire's construction on the moon had disrupted the hunting cycle and had killed many trees, Chirpa decided that the Ewoks would join with their new tribe members and fight the Empire.<ref name="ROTJNovel">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'']]</ref> When the time came, his warriors were courageous and skillful in the face of a superior enemy and managed to defeat them.<ref name="ROTJ" />

After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|battle]], Chirpa convinced [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] to lead a ceremony to promote Wicket to "lead warrior."<ref name="GalaxyGuide5" /> As a token of friendship between the Alliance and the Ewoks, Chirpa gave Leia a bracelet made of gold, a handsome gift as any metal was a precious commodity to the Ewoks.<ref name="TTAB">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref> Later on, following Chirpa's death, his daughter, Princess Kneesaa, became the new chief of Bright Tree Village in a [[Wedding of Wicket Wystri Warrick and Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka|ceremony]] that doubled as her wedding to Wicket Warrick.<ref name="Databank" /><ref name="Alien">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Chirpa_kiss_kneesaa.jpg|thumb|180px|Chirpa and Kneesaa.]]
In [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], Chief Chirpa was played by [[Jane Busby]]. In the animated television series [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']], he was voiced by [[George Buza]] in the first season and [[Rick Cimino]] in the second.

An action figure of Chief Chirpa was made in [[1983]] as part of Kenner's ''Return of the Jedi'' Collection and included a staff and hood.

In the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' Chirpa shared his game model and profile image with [[Simon (Ewok)|Simon]], a character who appeared via cheat code.<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>

An action figure of Chief Chirpa was made in [[2006]] as part of Hasbro's Saga Collection in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] wave and included a knife, sheath, staff, and hood. One of six bonus holographic figures were also included, as was a personalized display base.

[[The LEGO Group]] sold a Chirpa minifigure in 2009, along with [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] and [[Paploo/Legends|Paploo]]. The figure was a simple re-print of the other Ewoks.
